help_text:
owa-graph teams - Joined teams, channels, channel messages

Shortcuts:
  joined    List my joined teams
  channels  List channels (--team <id>)
  messages  List channel messages (--team --channel [--top])
  send      Post a channel message (--team --channel --body)
  members   List team members (--team <id>)

Common flags accepted by every shortcut:
  --pretty   Human-readable output (table for known shapes, indented JSON otherwise)
  --ndjson   Stream collection items one JSON object per line
  --retry    Honor Retry-After once on 429/503
